# Intelligence UI for DeepSeek Harness
**Chat replies that render as interfaces, not walls of Markdown.**

A plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that upgrades the assistant-message renderer:
model-authored Ope

nUI Lang fences render as cards, tables,
charts and diagrams in place, while structured Markdown is

automatically compiled into the same
visual language. Plain text stays plain text.

## Why not plain Markdown?

Markdown is excellent for prose but poor at structure: KPI comparisons turn into walls of text,
tabl

es lose hierarchy on mobile, and trends are invisible. Intelligence UI keeps Markdown for the
parts
that are prose and upgrades the rest:

- **Structure where it matters** — metrics, comparisons, timelines, steps, trees, charts and code
ch

anges render in their natural form instead of ASCII tables.
- **Fast to read** — compact previews, a

ligned numbers, semantic status colours, one accent per
screen.
- **Safe by construction** — a bad p

rogram never breaks the message; invalid input degrades to a
local notice or plain text.
- **No new
app, no build** — it ships as one directory bundle inside the chat you already use.

The repository contains both halves of the plugin: a host half that injects prompt modules
(`index.j

s`) and a browser half that registers the renderer (`src/` → `lib/client.js`). Component
implementat

ions are split into focused modules under `src/ui/`; the tolerant binding layer and
render pipeline

live in `src/openui-runtime.jsx`. Isolation boundaries, resource budgets, streaming
identity and cli
pboard/timer cleanup are described in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

## Privacy & telemetry

The plugin itself has **no analytics, no telemetry and makes no network requests**. Installing the
d

evelopment dependencies does not send telemetry either: the upstream `@openuidev/lang-core`
install

hook is explicitly denied in this repository's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (see
SECURITY.md). Remote image

s
that a user or model references through the `Image` component are loaded by the host, like any oth

er
chat image. The bundled upstream `@openuidev/lang-core` telemetry path is disabled unless the hos

t
explicitly sets `OPENUI_RUNTIME_TELEMETRY_ENABLED`; the browser runtime never enables it (the
iner

t upstream code is documented in SECURITY.md). Clipboard access happens only
through user-initiated

de is documented in SECURITY.md). Clipboard access happens only
through user-initiated copy buttons.
## Language support

The component library and host API are locale-neutral. The injected prompt modules, example
programs

and gallery content are currently written in **Chinese**, the primary language of the
first release

; an English prompt set is on the roadmap. UI chrome rendered by the plugin itself is
[该节后续省略]
## Limitations

- The map is schematic: an equirectangular projection with a simplified world outline — suitable
for

distributions and routes, not for navigation.
- On 390px screens, tree/diagram figures scale to fit

(labels get small) instead of scrolling.
- Expand state is per message, not persisted across replie

s.
- Auto-compilation only recognises clear structures; prose numbers are not turned into charts.
-

The tolerance layer fixes syntax, not semantics: swapped values cannot be detected.
- Rendering depe

nds on host internals (renderer slot, theme tokens, platform module table); a host
upgrade may requi

als (renderer slot, theme tokens, platform module table); a host
upgrade may require plugin changes.
